entities.name: Marked Ones
entities.description: Shamanistic barbarian tribe of the Balduvian Steppes.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Sorcerer who poisoned the Marked Ones' water to use their dead in his army.

entities.name: Samiks
entities.description: Dying Marked One who told the Kjeldorans what had happened.

entities.name: Kjeldorans
entities.description: People of Kjeldor who aided the Marked Ones.

entities.name: Bolar
entities.description: Sorcerer who administered a Healing Salve to the Marked Ones.

entities.name: Balduvians
entities.description: People of the Balduvian Steppes who later allied with Kjeldor.

entities.name: Balduvian Steppes
entities.description: Steppes of Dominaria inhabited by the Marked Ones.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl poisons the Marked Ones' water to use their dead bodies in his army and steal their artifacts.
events.quote: Their water was poisoned by Lim-Dûl

events.summary: Kjeldorans find the dying Marked One Samiks, who tells them what happened.
events.quote: Kjeldorans later happened upon a dying Marked One named Samiks

events.summary: Bolar cures the Marked Ones of the poison with a Healing Salve, an early step toward a Kjeldoran-Balduvian alliance.
events.quote: the sorcerer Bolar administered a Healing Salve to cure them of Lim-Dûl's poison

relations.quote: Their water was poisoned by Lim-Dûl

relations.note: bonds that would later bloom into a full alliance
relations.quote: which would later bloom into a full alliance
